tha-ap299:1.1: Desakittiyo.] Upasālaka-nāmo 'haṃ ahosiṃ brāhmaṇo tadā / kānanaṃ vanam ogāḷhaṃ lokajeṭṭhaṃ narāsabhaṃ // //
tha-ap299:2.1: Disvāna vandiṃ pādesu lokāhutipaṭiggahaṃ / pasannacittaṃ maṃ ñatvā Buddho antaradhāyatha. // //
tha-ap299:3.1: Kānanā abhinikkhamma Buddhaseṭṭham anussariṃ / taṃ desaṃ kittayitvāna kappaṃ saggamhi mod' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap299:4.1: Dvenavute ito kappe yaṃ desam abhikittayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi kittanāya idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap299:6.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Desakittiyo thero i. g. a-ti.
